name: Seven Hill Industries Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1990, Seven Hill Industries Ltd is registered as a Non-Banking Financial Company.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
SHIL used to provide various financial-related services in India. It is engaged in the business of non-banking financial services, such as trading in shares and securities, investment loans, and advances. The company provides financial services through a separate division namely Shivom Financial Services. Apart from this, it is also present in the software trading business.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.61 times its book value
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
